🩺 [HEALTH] SSV watch: monitor-stall — mainnet
The Monitor is not keeping up: its last block 26260740 has not changed for 275 s. Not positively known to keep up since 275 s (stall 4). None of its rules (M8 events, M10, M11 info, M13, M15, transfers, DAO/Safe, oracle transactions, the failed-tx inbox for M1/M2) evaluates anything meanwhile; an empty inbox proves nothing. Blocks it skips when it resumes (more than max_past_blocks 50 behind) are announced as monitor-skipped.

🩺 [HEALTH] SSV watch: monitor-skipped — mainnet
The Monitor's last processed block jumped from 26260740 to 26260810: blocks 26260741-26260759 (19) were NOT evaluated by its rules and will not be (it was more than max_past_blocks (50) behind when it resumed; such blocks are never recorded as missed, so recovery_config does not retry them). Check them by hand (proxy logs, failed transactions to the proxy, transfers to the watched addresses). If it resumed in several quick cycles between two reads of the worker (a catch-up cycle can outlast the cron), the true range ends earlier: this range is never too short.

🩺 [HEALTH] SSV watch: monitor-recovered — mainnet
The Monitor processes blocks again: last block 26260810, 3 blocks behind the head 26260813; stall 4 lasted 816 s.
